text: An isotopy of embeddings of a compact source manifold into a smooth target extends to an ambient isotopy of the target. The proof extends the velocity field from the compact traced image and makes it vanish outside a compact neighborhood. Compactness is required of the source, not of the ambient manifold.

source.title: Manifolds
source.author: Bruno Martelli
source.locator: February5,2020 edition, Theorem5.3.3 and proof, printed120–121 / PDF126–127

scope: Ambient extension of an isotopy of embeddings of a compact source manifold; specialize the source to a circle and the ambient manifold to a finite-dimensional real vector space.
